label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockIntro
text:
So, we meet again.\pBack in MT. MOON, I didn't
introduce myself properly.\pI'm BROCK.
PEWTER CITY's GYM LEADER.\pYou showed a keen eye for
fossils out there.\pBut finding fragments is only
part of the story.\pUnderstanding how they connect...
that's where true strength lies.\pThere's something I want to show
you about evolution.\pBut first-you'll have to
defeat me in battle.\pLet's see what you've learned!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockNotEnoughPokemon
text: So, we meet again.\pWait, you don't have enough POKéMON\nto battle me.\pCome back when you have\nmore POKéMON in your party.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDefeat
text: I took you for granted...\nand I lost.\pYou understood more than\njust the battle.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_TakeThisWithYou
text: Wait.\pTake this-\nthe BOULDERBADGE.\pAnd with it, the key to\nthe CINNABAR LAB.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBoulderKeyFromBrock
text: {PLAYER} received the BOULDER KEY\nfrom BROCK.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBoulderBadge
text:
The BOULDERBADGE grants access
to the CINNABAR LAB.\pThat's where fossils are studied
and restored.\pBut fossils aren't the only way
to study the past.\pSome POKéMON never vanished.
They still live... unchanged.\pDeep below ROCK TUNNEL,
ancient waters shelter POKéMON\lolder than anything restored.\pFind one. Bring it to me.\pThen I'll show you another kind
of evolution.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockRelicanthReminder
text: Deep below ROCK TUNNEL,\nancient waters still shelter\lPOKéMON from another age.\pFind one and bring it to me.\nThen I'll show you trade evolution.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockOfferTrade
text: Now watch closely.\pSome evolution happens through\ninteraction between TRAINERS.\pWill you trade your ancient\nPOKéMON for my GRAVELER?$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDeclineTrade
text: No rush.\pWhen you're ready, bring\nthe ancient POKéMON back to me.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockTradeComplete
text: There it is...\nGOLEM.\pThat's trade evolution.\pA change brought about by\nexchange between TRAINERS.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockTradeDone
text: GOLEM is proof that evolution\ncan be shaped by connection.\pRemember that as you continue\nOAK's research.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockPostBattle
text: Deep below ROCK TUNNEL,\nancient waters still shelter\lPOKéMON from another age.\pFind one and bring it to me.\nThen I'll show you trade evolution.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockNotRelicanth
text: That's not the POKéMON\nI was hoping to study.\pLook for one that has lived\nunchanged since ancient times.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyBrockInMtMoon
text: BROCK's out in MT. MOON right now,\nsearching for fossils! You should\lgo find him there.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyBrockStillAway
text: BROCK's still away from the GYM.\nTry looking in MT. MOON.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetMeTakeYouToTheTop
text: Ah, BROCK's back from MT. MOON!\pLooks like your fossil hunting\ngave him something to think about.\pWant some advice before you\nchallenge him?$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetsGetHappening
text: All right!\nLet's dig deep!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockTypeAdvice
text:
BROCK uses ROCK-type POKéMON.\pThey resist NORMAL and FIRE.
Don't rely on brute force.\pWATER and GRASS moves are
especially effective.\pGROUND moves can also
break through their defense.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ItsFreeLetsGetHappening
text: All right!\pThen go show BROCK what you\nlearned in MT. MOON!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_YoureChampMaterial
text: Just as I thought!\nYou're POKéMON champ material!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyIntro
text:
Hey! You made it back!\pThanks for guiding me through
ROCK TUNNEL's currents.\pThe POWER PLANT is stable again,
and I learned a lot watching how\lyou handled the flow.\pWater is beautiful because it
changes without losing itself.\pNow it's time for an official
GYM challenge.\pMy policy is an all-out offensive
with WATER-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainWaterPulse
text: WATER PULSE sends rippling water\nat the foe.\pUse it on an aquatic POKéMON!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCascadeBadge
text:
That BADGE marks a real change
in your journey.\pKeep building your FIELD AIDE
record, and outsider POKéMON\lwill trust you more.\pA puny fish can become a mighty,
raging POKéMON.\pThat's the beauty of change.\pBring me that GYARADOS.
Then I'll show you trade evolution\lwith a natural held item.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_TakeThisWithYou
text: You can have the CASCADEBADGE.\pAnd with it, take this board.\nIt will carry you across water.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedCascadeBoardFromMisty
text: {PLAYER} received the CASCADE BOARD\nfrom MISTY.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_UnusedMistyReward
text: {PLAYER} received something\nfrom MISTY.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_BetterMakeRoomForThis
text: You better make room for this!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyDefeat
text: Wow!\nYou're too much!\pAll right!\pYou can have the CASCADEBADGE to\nshow you beat me.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyGyaradosReminder
text: A puny fish can become a mighty,\nraging POKéMON.\pThat's the beauty of change.\pBring me that GYARADOS.\nThen I'll show you trade evolution\lwith a natural held item.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyOfferTrade
text:
You brought GYARADOS?
Perfect!\pSome POKéMON evolve when traded
while holding something natural.\pMy POLIWHIRL is holding a
KING'S ROCK.\pWill you trade GYARADOS
for my POLIWHIRL?$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyDeclineTrade
text: No rush.\pBring me GYARADOS when you want\nto see that evolution in motion.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyNotGyarados
text: That's not the mighty POKéMON\nthat grows from MAGIKARP.\pBring me GYARADOS and I'll show\nyou something interesting.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyTradeComplete
text: There it is...\nPOLITOED!\pA POLIWHIRL traded with a\nKING'S ROCK can change into\lsomething completely new.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyTradeDone
text: POLITOED is proof that evolution\ncan follow the flow of an item\land a trade.\pKeep watching how beautifully\nPOKéMON can change.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaIntro
text: What? You?\nI'm more than good enough for you!\pMISTY won't have to be bothered.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaDefeat
text: You overwhelmed me!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaPostBattle
text: You have to face other TRAINERS\nto see how good you really are.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLet me give you some advice!\pThe LEADER, MISTY, is a pro who
uses WATER-type POKéMON.\pYou can drain all their water with
GRASS-type POKéMON.\pOr, you might use ELECTRIC-type
POKéMON and zap them!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyBackFromRockTunnel
text: MISTY's back from ROCK TUNNEL!\pSounds like guiding her through\nthose currents helped settle\lsomething big.\pWant some advice before you\nchallenge her?$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyLetsMakeWaves
text: All right!\nLet's make waves!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyShowMisty
text: All right!\pThen go show MISTY what you\nlearned in ROCK TUNNEL!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideMistyAway
text: Hold up!\pMISTY's away from the GYM.\nShe's investigating the water\lcurrents running through\lROCK TUNNEL.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideMistyStillAway
text: MISTY's still away from the GYM.\pTry checking the water currents\ninside ROCK TUNNEL.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_WeMakePrettyGoodTeam
text: You beat MISTY!\nSee, what'd I tell ya?\pYou and me, kid, we make a pretty\ndarn-good team!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeIntro
text:
So, you made it back, kid!\pI'm LT. SURGE.
VERMILION CITY's GYM LEADER.\pYou handled VOLT TACKLE training
without flinching.\pThat takes nerve!\pPower isn't handed to you.
You train until you can hold it!\pBut a GYM battle is combat!
No holding back!\pI tell you, kid, electric POKéMON
saved me during the war!\pNow show me you can stand against
real voltage!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgePostBattle
text: A little word of advice, kid!\pElectricity is sure powerful!\pBut training is how you make\nthat power obey!\pBut, it's useless against GROUND-\ntype POKéMON!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TakeThisWithYou
text: The THUNDERBADGE proves you\ncleared VERMILION GYM!\pAnd with it, take this pass.\nIt'll get you special MART stock.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedThunderPassFromLtSurge
text: {PLAYER} received the THUNDER PASS\nfrom LT. SURGE.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainThunderBadge
text:
That pass unlocks vitamins and
battle items at POKéMON MARTS.\pPower isn't handed to you.
Use those tools and train until\lyour POKéMON can hold it.\pBring me a RAICHU with real
voltage.\pThen I'll show you evolution
through serious output.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeOfferElectabuzzTrade
text: Hey, kid!\pYou've got a RAICHU with real\nvoltage, right?\pI've got an ELECTABUZZ holding\nan ELECTIRIZER.\pTrade me your RAICHU for it?$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeDeclineElectabuzzTrade
text: No pressure, kid!\pCome back when you're ready to\nhandle that kind of power.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeNotRaichu
text: That's not RAICHU, kid!\pBring me the real lightning rod.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeElectabuzzTradeComplete
text: Hah!\nNow that's a power surge!\pThat ELECTIRIZER ought to wake up\nsomething fierce in ELECTABUZZ.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeElectabuzzTradeDone
text: That ELECTABUZZ was built for\nserious output.\pKeep it charged, kid!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_UnusedSurgeReward
text: {PLAYER} received something\nfrom LT. SURGE.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave
text: SHOCK WAVE is an ELECTRIC move!\pTeach it to an ELECTRIC POKéMON!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_MakeRoomInYourBag
text: Yo, kid, make room in your BAG!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeDefeat
text: Now that's a shocker!\pYou're the real deal, kid!\pFine, then, take the THUNDERBADGE!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerIntro
text: When I was in the Army, LT. SURGE\nwas my strict CO.\pHe was a hard taskmaster.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerDefeat
text: Stop!\nYou're very good!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerPostBattle
text: It's not easy opening that door.\pLT. SURGE was always famous for\nhis cautious nature in the Army.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyIntro
text: I'm a lightweight, but I'm good\nwith electricity!\pThat's why I joined this GYM.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyDefeat
text: Fried!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyPostBattle
text: Okay, I'll talk!\pLT. SURGE said he hid door\nswitches inside something.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwayneIntro
text: This is no place for kids!\nNot even if you're good!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwayneDefeat
text: Wow!\nSurprised me!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwaynePostBattle
text:
LT. SURGE installed the traps in
the GYM himself.\pHe set up double locks everywhere.
Let me give you a hint.\pWhen you open the first lock, the
second lock is right next to it.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
LT. SURGE has a nickname.\pPeople refer to him as the
Lightning Unovan!\pHe's an expert on electric
POKéMON.\pFLYING/WATER-type POKéMON match
poorly against the ELECTRIC type.\pBeware of paralysis, too.\pLT. SURGE is very cautious.\pHis POKéMON fight in pairs.
Bring two of your own to fight!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuySurgeReturned
text:
Ah, LT. SURGE is back from
DIGLETT'S CAVE!\pSounds like he put you through
some serious training.\pWant some advice before you
challenge him?$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyLetsGetCharged
text: All right!\nLet's get charged up!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyShowSurge
text: All right!\pThen go show LT. SURGE what you\nlearned in DIGLETT'S CAVE!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuySurgeAway
text: Hold it, kid!\pLT. SURGE is away from the GYM.\nHe's training in DIGLETT'S CAVE.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuySurgeStillAway
text: LT. SURGE is still away from the\nGYM.\pTry looking in DIGLETT'S CAVE.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
text: Whew!\nThat match was electric!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaIntro
text:
Hello…
Lovely weather, isn't it?\lIt's so pleasant…\p…Oh, dear…
I must have dozed off. Welcome.\pMy name is ERIKA.
I am the LEADER of CELADON GYM.\pI am a student of the art of
flower arranging.\pMy POKéMON are solely of the
GRASS type.\p…Oh, I'm sorry, I had no idea that
you wished to challenge me.\pVery well, but I shall not lose.{PLAY_BGM MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaDefeat
text: Oh!\nI concede defeat.\lYou are remarkably strong.\pI must confer on you the\nRAINBOWBADGE.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaPostBattle
text: You are cataloging POKéMON?\nI must say I'm impressed.\pI would never collect POKéMON if\nthey were unattractive.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaWaitingForChallenge
text: ERIKA is away from the GYM.\pPlease look for her in\nVIRIDIAN FOREST.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaReward
text:
Thank you for coming.\pYour challenge in VIRIDIAN FOREST
was witnessed and official.\pThat forest reminded me that
growth comes through friendship.\pSome POKéMON even evolve when
that friendship is allowed to\lflourish.\pWhen people and POKéMON support
one another, all may bloom.\pYou have already earned the
RAINBOWBADGE.\pNow, please accept a POKéMON
that shows how friendship can\lhelp life bloom.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRainbowBadgeTakeThis
text: Outsider POKéMON respond to more\nthan BADGES alone.\pYour FIELD AIDE record shows how\ndeeply you understand them.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedRainbowKeyFromErika
text: {PLAYER} received the RAINBOW KEY\nfrom ERIKA.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaGiftBudew
text: Please also accept this BUDEW.\pRaise it with kindness, and one\nday friendship may help it bloom.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBudewFromErika
text: {PLAYER} received BUDEW\nfrom ERIKA.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaBudewAdvice
text: BUDEW evolves through friendship\nduring the day.\pCare for it well, and it will show\nyou how trust becomes growth.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaRoseliaReminder
text: Raise BUDEW with kindness during\nthe day.\pWhen ROSELIA is recorded in your\nPOKéDEX, our lesson will bloom.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaRoseliaConfirmed
text: Your POKéDEX records ROSELIA.\pFriendship has guided growth into\nbloom. Wonderful.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideErikaAway
text:
Excuse me!\pERIKA is away from the GYM.
She's somewhere in VIRIDIAN\lFOREST.\pShe mentioned searching for an
ENERGY ROOT with healing properties.\pShe said roots teach how living
things support each other.\pShe's been gone for some time…
I should go find her.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideErikaStillAway
text: ERIKA is still away from the GYM.\pPlease look for her in\nVIRIDIAN FOREST.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideErikaImpressed
text:
I was honored to witness your
battle with ERIKA.\pYou and your POKéMON supported
one another beautifully.\pPlease speak with ERIKA.
Your reward is waiting.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: You bloomed brilliantly against\nERIKA's garden of POKéMON.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_UnusedErikaReward
text: {PLAYER} received something\nfrom ERIKA.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainGigaDrain
text: GIGA DRAIN heals the user for\nhalf the damage it inflicts.\pThat strength through renewal is\na beautiful thing.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ShouldMakeRoomForThis
text: You should make room for this.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayIntro
text: I should tell you about this GYM.\pOnly real ladies are allowed in\nhere!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayDefeat
text: You're too rough!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayPostBattle
text: Bleaah!\nI hope ERIKA wipes you out!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetIntro
text: Oh, welcome.\nI was getting bored.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetDefeat
text: My makeup!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetPostBattle
text: GRASS-type POKéMON are tough\nagainst the WATER type.\pThey also have an edge on ROCK-\nand GROUND-type POKéMON.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaIntro
text: …Weren't you peeking in here\nearlier?$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaDefeat
text: You're an eye-opener!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaPostBattle
text: Oh, you were looking at ERIKA…\nYou weren't looking at me…$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaIntro
text: Look, look!\nSee my POKéMON!\pI like the GRASS type.\nI like how they're easy to raise.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaDefeat
text: No!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaPostBattle
text: We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at\nour GYM.\pWhy? We also use them for making\nflower arrangements!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaIntro
text: Oh, hey!\pWe don't like BUG- or FIRE-type\nPOKéMON in here!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaDefeat
text: Oh!\nYou!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaPostBattle
text: Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet,\nbut she's famous around here.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriIntro
text: Pleased to meet you.\nMy hobby is POKéMON training.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriDefeat
text: Oh!\nSplendid!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriPostBattle
text: I have a blind date coming up.\nI have to learn to be polite,\lespecially if I have to battle.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaIntro
text:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pA mere child like you dares to
challenge me?\pThe very idea makes me shiver
with mirth!\pVery well, I shall show you true
terror as a ninja master.\pPoison brings steady doom.
Sleep renders foes helpless.\pDespair to the creeping horror of
POISON-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaDefeat
text: Humph!\nYou have proven your worth!\pHere!\nTake the SOULBADGE!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostBattle
text: When afflicted by TOXIC, a POKéMON\nsuffers more and more.\pIt suffers worsening damage as the\nbattle wears on!\pIt will surely terrorize foes!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaWaitingForChallenge
text: KOGA is away from the GYM.\pPlease look for him in\nCINNABAR VOLCANO.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainSoulBadge
text: Now that you have the SOULBADGE,\nyou have proven your worth in\nFUCHSIA GYM.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedSoulPassFromKoga
text: {PLAYER} received the SOUL PASS\nfrom KOGA.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaReward
text:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pThe LAVIC STONE is secure, and
your challenge was witnessed.\pYou earned the SOULBADGE in
CINNABAR VOLCANO.\pAccept another tool of
togetherness.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaGiftGolbat
text: Take this GOLBAT as well.\pIt has trained beside my clan and\nunderstands the strength of trust.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedGolbatFromKoga
text: {PLAYER} received GOLBAT\nfrom KOGA.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaGolbatAdvice
text: GOLBAT evolves through friendship.\pMove with it as one, and it may\nbecome a CROBAT.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaCrobatReminder
text: Train beside GOLBAT and earn\nits trust.\pWhen CROBAT is recorded in your\nPOKéDEX, the lesson is complete.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaCrobatConfirmed
text: KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pYour POKéDEX records CROBAT.\pTrust has sharpened your strength\ninto something worthy.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostReward
text: KOGA: True strength is not only\nhidden in the self.\pIt sharpens when a community\nmoves together.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_UnusedKogaReward
text: {PLAYER} received something\nfrom KOGA.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainToxic
text: TOXIC is a poison technique.\pIt is a secret technique dating\nback some four hundred years.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_MakeSpaceForThis
text: Make space for this, child!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenIntro
text: Strength isn't the key for POKéMON.\nDo you understand this?\pPOKéMON is about strategy!\pI'll show you how strategy can\nbeat brute strength.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenDefeat
text: What?\nExtraordinary!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle
text: So, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!\pThat's remarkable for a child\nTRAINER.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
text: I was a magician once upon a time.\pBut I dreamt of becoming a ninja,\nso I joined this GYM.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
text: I'm done for!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
text: Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\lof KOGA, my ninja master.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
text: Let's see you beat my special\ntechniques!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
text: You had me fooled!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
text: I like poison and sleep techniques,\nas they linger after battle!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro
text: Stop right there!\pThe famed invisible walls of\nFUCHSIA GYM have you frustrated?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilDefeat
text: Whoa!\nYou've got it!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle
text: You impressed me!\nHere's a hint!\pLook very closely for gaps in the\ninvisible walls!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarIntro
text: I also study the way of the ninja\nwith Master KOGA!\pNinja have a long history of using\nanimals!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarDefeat
text: Awoo!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarPostBattle
text: I still have much to learn.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
text: Master KOGA comes from a long line\nof ninjas.\pWhat did you descend from?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
text: You're more skilled than I'd\nthought!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
text: Where there is light, there is\nshadow!\pLight and shadow!\nWhich do you choose?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pFUCHSIA GYM is a tricked-up place.
It's riddled with invisible walls!\pKOGA might appear close, but he's
blocked off.\pYou have to find gaps in the walls
to reach him.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideKogaAway
text:
JANINE: My father KOGA disappeared
in a puff of smoke before my eyes!\pBefore he vanished, he spoke of
crafting new tools from volcanic\lrock found in CINNABAR VOLCANO.\pI had better hurry and help my
father, our clan leader!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideKogaStillAway
text: KOGA is away searching for\nvolcanic rock in CINNABAR VOLCANO.\pI should hurry after my father\nand help our clan leader.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideKogaImpressed
text:
I was honored to witness your
trial with KOGA.\pThe way you worked together to free
that LAVIC STONE was remarkable.\pPlease speak with KOGA.
Your reward is waiting.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
text: It's amazing how ninja can terrify,\neven now!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro
text:
I had a vision of your arrival.\pI am SABRINA.
SAFFRON CITY's GYM LEADER.\pYou kept your mind steady within
POKéMON TOWER's astral pull.\pI have had psychic powers since
I was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I
carelessly tossed, bent.\pI dislike battling, but if you wish,
I will show you my powers!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaDefeat
text:
This loss shocks me!
But, a loss is a loss.\pI admit, I didn't work hard enough
to win.\pYour victory has earned you the
MARSHBADGE.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle
text: Psychic power isn't something that\nonly a few people have.\pEveryone has psychic power.\nPeople just don't realize it.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostFieldVictory
text: POKéMON TOWER's astral pressure\nhas settled.\pThe MARSHBADGE is proof that your\nmind held firm within it.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshBadgeTakeThis
text: A calm mind earns trust from\neven strong outsider POKéMON.\pKeep completing PROF. OAK's\nsubquests to strengthen that bond.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMarshFinderFromSabrina
text: {PLAYER} received the MARSH FINDER\nfrom SABRINA.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshFinder
text: The MARSH FINDER senses hidden\nobjects nearby.\pA calm mind can notice what the\neyes alone overlook.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pSABRINA's POKéMON use psychic
power instead of force.\pFIGHTING POKéMON are especially
weak against PSYCHIC POKéMON.\pThey'll get destroyed before they
can even aim a punch!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideSabrinaAway
text: SABRINA left for POKéMON TOWER\nafter feeling a psychic pull\ltoward it.\pShe said it was likely the\ngathering of a massive amount\lof astral energy.\pI'd better head there myself.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideSabrinaStillAway
text: SABRINA is at POKéMON TOWER,\ndrawn there by astral energy.\pBring her a POKéMON that can\nlearn DREAM EATER.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideSabrinaReturned
text:
SABRINA is back from
POKéMON TOWER!\pShe said you held steady inside
a powerful astral current.\pWant some advice before you
challenge her?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyFocusYourMind
text: All right!\nFocus your mind!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyShowSabrina
text: All right!\pThen go show SABRINA what you\nlearned in POKéMON TOWER!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
text: Psychic power, huh?\pIf I had that, I'd make a bundle\nat the slots!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro
text:
Hah!\pI am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER
of CINNABAR GYM!\pFire is more than destruction.
Properly handled, it drives\linnovation and progress!\pMy fiery POKéMON are ready to
test your next breakthrough!\pHah!
You better have BURN HEAL!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineDefeat
text: I have burned down to nothing!\nNot even ashes remain!\pYou have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_FireBlastIsUltimateFireMove
text: FIRE BLAST is the ultimate fire\ntechnique.\pDon't waste it on WATER POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ExplainVolcanoBadge
text: Hah!\pThe VOLCANOBADGE proves you\nsurvived CINNABAR GYM's heat.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineUnlockPorygonMachine
text:
But a BADGE is only proof of what
you have already survived.\pProgress asks what you can build
next!\pThe machine by my desk can compile
a POKéMON from research data.\pAnswer its sequence correctly, and
generate PORYGON yourself!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePostBattle
text: Fire is the engine of progress!\pTreat it with discipline, and it\ncan light the way to tomorrow.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePorygonMachineAvailable
text: The machine by my desk is ready.\pGo on!\nTurn research into a POKéMON!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PorygonMachineInitialize
text: PORYGON generator online.\pInitialize build sequence?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PorygonMachineRules
text: Build a stable virtual POKéMON by\nchoosing the correct parameters.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PorygonMachineQuestionStablePattern
text: Should the base form be coded from\na stable geometric pattern?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PorygonMachineQuestionRandomNoise
text: Should random noise overwrite the\ncore data?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PorygonMachineQuestionProjection
text: Should the completed data receive\na physical projection?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PorygonMachineParameterAccepted
text: Parameter accepted.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PorygonMachineBuildFailed
text: Parameter rejected!\pThe build collapsed into static.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PorygonMachineGenerated
text: The machine compiled the data into\nPORYGON!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PorygonMachineAlreadyGenerated
text: The PORYGON generator hums quietly.\pIts last pattern is safely archived.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PorygonMachineCancel
text: Sequence cancelled.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_MakeSpaceForThis
text: Make space for this, child!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikIntro
text: Do you know how hot POKéMON fire\nbreath can get?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikDefeat
text: Yow!\nHot, hot, hot!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikPostBattle
text: Fire, or to be more precise,\ncombustion…\p…Oxygen in the air…\nBlah, blah, blah, blah…$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnIntro
text: I was a thief, but I went straight\nas a TRAINER.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnDefeat
text: I surrender!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnPostBattle
text: I get this uncontrollable urge to\nsteal other people's POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryIntro
text: I've studied POKéMON thoroughly.\nYou can't win!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryDefeat
text: Waah!\nMy studies were insufficient!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryPostBattle
text: My theories are too complicated\nfor you to understand.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonIntro
text: I like using FIRE-type POKéMON.\nI just do.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonDefeat
text: Too hot to handle!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonPostBattle
text: I wish there were a thief POKéMON.\nI'd use that!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekIntro
text: I know why BLAINE became a\nTRAINER.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekDefeat
text: Ow!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekPostBattle
text:
Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good.\pNight fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared.\pIts light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyIntro
text: I've been to many GYMS, but this\none best suits my style.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyDefeat
text: Yowza!\nToo hot!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyPostBattle
text: PONYTA, NINETALES…\nThose are popular FIRE POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacIntro
text: Fire is weak against H2O.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacDefeat
text: Oh!\nSnuffed out!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacPostBattle
text: Water beats fire, of course.\pBut fire melts ice, so the FIRE\ntype beats ICE-type POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pThe hotheaded BLAINE is a FIRE
POKéMON pro.\pDouse his spirits with water!\pYou'd better take some
BURN HEALS, too.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
text: {PLAYER}!\nYou beat that firebrand!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PokemonQuizRules
text:
POKéMON Quiz!\pGet it right, and the door opens to
the next room.\pGet it wrong, and face a TRAINER!\pIf you want to conserve your
POKéMON for the GYM LEADER…\pThen get it right!
Here we go!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion1
text: CATERPIE evolves into METAPOD?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion2
text: There are nine certified POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion3
text: POLIWAG evolves three times?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion4
text: Are electric moves effective\nagainst GROUND-type POKéMON?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion5
text: POKéMON of the same kind and level\nare not identical?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion6
text: This contains TOMBSTONY?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_CorrectGoOnThrough
text: You're absolutely correct!\pGo on through!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_SorryBadCall
text: Sorry!\nBad call!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniIntro
text:
GIOVANNI: You have seen me seek
power in ruins, in industry, and\lbefore MEWTWO itself.\pEvery time, you stood in my way.\pVery well.
No machines. No inventions.\lNo stolen advantage.\pOnly a TRAINER and his team.\pFace GIOVANNI, LEADER of the
VIRIDIAN GYM!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniDefeat
text: Ha!\nThat was a truly intense fight.\lYou have won!\pAs proof, here is the EARTHBADGE!\n{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
text:
GIOVANNI: I chased absolute power
because I mistook control for\lstrength.\pA creature in a vat.
A BALL that never fails.\lA command no one could refuse.\pBut MEWTWO answered control with
defiance.\pMy own POKéMON answered trust.\pYou stood before power without
trying to own it.\pYou trusted your team, and they
trusted you.\pThat is what I had forgotten.
That is what TEAM ROCKET must\llearn.\pAs of today, TEAM ROCKET changes
course.\pNo more shadows.
No more conquest.\pI will begin again, not as a tyrant,
but as a TRAINER.\pFarewell, {PLAYER}.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainEarthBadgeTakeThis
text:
The EARTHBADGE is evidence of
your mastery as a TRAINER.\pBut obedience is earned through
the trust recorded in your\lFIELD AIDE work.\pWith it, you can challenge the
POKéMON LEAGUE.\pGo. Your path lies ahead.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pEven I don't know the VIRIDIAN
LEADER's identity.\pBut one thing's certain.
This will be the toughest of all\lthe GYM LEADERS.\pAlso, I heard that the TRAINERS
here like GROUND-type POKéMON.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
text: Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the\nGYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ?\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
text: VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: GIOVANNI\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: MtMoon_Text_BrockFirstMeeting
text:
Hey, watch your step. These tunnels
are unstable... but that's where the\lgood finds are.\pYou're not just passing through,
are you?\pYou've got that look...
like you're searching for something.\pThis place is full of them-
fragments of ancient POKéMON.\pOne fragment on its own doesn't
tell you much...\lbut combine the right ones...\p...and you might get something close
to what used to live here.\pIf you find a fossil around
here, show it to me.\lI'd like to see what you're made of!$

label: MtMoon_Text_BrockStillSearching
text: Still searching?\nKeep your eyes on the ground.\pMT. MOON has a way of hiding\nhistory in plain sight.$

label: MtMoon_Text_BrockSawHelixShard
text: That's a HELIX FOSSIL!\pSharp ridges... light structure...\nThis belonged to something built\lfor speed.\pGood eye. You found something\nwith real historical value.$

label: MtMoon_Text_BrockGaveDartShard
text: BROCK gave you a\nDART FOSSIL.$

label: MtMoon_Text_BrockSawDomeShard
text: That's a DOME FOSSIL!\pDense curve... strong shell...\nThis belonged to something built\lto endure.\pGood eye. You found something\nwith real historical value.$

label: MtMoon_Text_BrockGaveHasteShard
text: BROCK gave you a\nHASTE FOSSIL.$

label: MtMoon_Text_BrockReturnToGym
text: You've got a good eye.\pMeet me back at the PEWTER GYM.\nThere's something I want to show\lyou about evolution.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_MistyScoutRequest
text:
Oh, hey!
You're all the way out here, too?\pThe POWER PLANT's been having
wild electrical surges lately.\pI think underground currents in
ROCK TUNNEL are feeding into it.\pThere's a POWER STATION up ahead,
but this tunnel splits around it.\pCould you scout ahead and tell me
which direction I should take?$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_ChooseDirection
text: Which way should I take from here?$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_TryLeft
text: LEFT?\nGot it! I'll test that current.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_LeftFailed
text: No good!\pThe current that way is too strong.\nIt loops back on itself.\pWhich way should I try?$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_TryRight
text: RIGHT?\nAll right, I'll follow that flow.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_MistyAtGenerator
text: This must be the generator.\pThe current brought me right to it.\nNow we can work out what's wrong.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_MistyGeneratorFixed
text: Thanks for guiding me here!\pI've got this generator stable\nagain.\pBut there are more surges ahead.\nI'm going to follow the current.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_MistyLowerScoutRequest
text: I can hear you through the wall!\pThere's a waterfall ahead, and I\ncan see the current branching.\pCould you scout for me again and\ntell me which way to take?$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_LowerChooseDirection
text: Which way should I take from here?$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_LowerTryLeft
text: LEFT?\nGot it! I'll check that branch.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_LowerTryRight
text: RIGHT?\nGot it! I'll check that branch.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_LowerLeftFailed
text: No good!\pThe current that way is too strong.\nIt loops back on itself.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_MistyAtSecondGenerator
text: This is the second generator.\pThe current carried me right to it.\nI'll check this one too.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_MistySecondGeneratorFixed
text: That steadied another surge!\pThere's still one more current\npulling deeper into the tunnel.\pI'm going to follow the opening\nand see where it branches.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_MistyAtThirdSection
text: There you are!\pThis exit leads past the second\ngenerator's current.\pI just need to reach the last\ngenerator now.\pWhich way should I take?$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_ThirdTryLeft
text: LEFT?\nGot it! I'll follow that path.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_ThirdTryRight
text: RIGHT?\nGot it! I'll test that current.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_ThirdRightFailed
text: No good!\pThe current that way is too strong.\nIt loops back on itself.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_MistyAtFinalGenerator
text:
That's it!\pThe POWER PLANT is fixed, and
the currents are calm again.\pAll this work brought positive
change to ROCK TUNNEL.\pI'm heading back to the GYM.
Come find me there, okay?\pI've got something interesting
about evolution to show you.$

label: RockTunnel_B2F_Text_MistyFound
text:
That's the way through?
Perfect, thanks!\pI'll follow that current and get
to the bottom of these surges.\pMeet me back at CERULEAN GYM
when you're ready.$

label: DiglettsCave_Southside_B1F_Text_LtSurgeTeachVoltTackle
text:
Hey, kid!\pI come to DIGLETT'S CAVE
regularly to train.\pDown here, I can go all out!\pThe powerful electric blasts from
my POKéMON are contained by the\lcave walls.\pWhile training here, I developed
an ELECTRIC-type move.\pWant me to teach it?\pYou'll need a POKéMON that can
learn it.$

label: DiglettsCave_Southside_B1F_Text_LtSurgeChoosePokemon
text: All right, kid!\nChoose the POKéMON to train.$

label: DiglettsCave_Southside_B1F_Text_LtSurgeComeBackWithPokemon
text: No problem, kid!\pCome back with a POKéMON that can\nhandle that kind of voltage.$

label: DiglettsCave_Southside_B1F_Text_LtSurgeTaughtVoltTackle
text:
That's VOLT TACKLE!\pIt's reckless, high-voltage power
packed into a full-body charge.\pHeh!
I like you, kid.\pYou've got the nerve to handle
real voltage.\pI'll meet you back at VERMILION
GYM.\pI want a battle with you!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_TangrowthApexCry
text: GREEEAOW!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_FriendsItchingToBattle
text: I came here with some friends to\ncatch us some BUG POKéMON!\pThey're all itching to get into\nsome POKéMON battles!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickIntro
text: Hey! You have POKéMON!\nCome on!\lLet's battle 'em!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickDefeat
text: No!\nCATERPIE got tangled up in the\nforest pace!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickPostBattle
text: Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away.\nAnother time, okay?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougIntro
text: Yo!\nYou can't jam out if you're a\lPOKéMON TRAINER!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougDefeat
text: Huh?\nI ran out of POKéMON!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougPostBattle
text: That totally stinks! I'm going to\ncatch some stronger ones!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyIntro
text: Hey, wait up!\nWhat's the hurry? Why the rush?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyDefeat
text: I give!\nYou're good at this!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyPostBattle
text: Sometimes, you can find stuff on\nthe ground.\pI'm looking for the stuff I\ndropped. Can you help me?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyIntro
text: I might be little, but I won't like\nit if you go easy on me!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyDefeat
text: Oh, boo.\nNothing went right.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
text: I lost some of my allowance…$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharlieIntro
text: Did you know that POKéMON evolve?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharlieDefeat
text: Oh!\nGuess evolving fast isn't the same\nas battling well.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharliePostBattle
text: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nThey're a lot of fun!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RanOutOfPokeBalls
text: I was throwing POKé BALLS to\ncatch POKéMON, and I ran out.\pThat's why you can never have too\nmany POKé BALLS.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaLookingForRoot
text:
ERIKA: Oh, hello.\pI came to VIRIDIAN FOREST in
search of an ENERGY ROOT.\pRoots are quiet things, yet they
bind a whole garden together.\pA root grown here is said to heal
because the forest shares its\lstrength as one family.\pI am certain one can be found
somewhere nearby.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaShownRoot
text:
ERIKA: Oh!
That ENERGY ROOT is splendid.\pSee how many tiny roots gather
into one strong whole?\pIt reminds me that families,
friends, and communities grow\lbest together.\pIf I could find one of my own, I
would gladly return to the GYM.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_GymGuideFoundErika
text:
ERIKA!
I am so glad I found you!\pAnd look, I found an ENERGY ROOT
on the way here.\pIt was tucked among other roots,
all holding the soil together.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaChallenge
text:
ERIKA: How fortunate.
That is just the lesson I hoped\lthis forest would offer.\pSome POKéMON bloom only when
friendship has taken root.\pThat kind of evolution is a bond,
not merely a change in form.\pBefore I return, may I ask you for
a proper GYM challenge?\pWith my GYM GUIDE present, the
match will be official.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaBattleIntro
text: Very well.\pShow me how friendship has helped\nyour POKéMON grow.\pLet us begin.{PLAY_BGM MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaDefeat
text: Oh!\nI concede defeat.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ErikaAfterBattle
text:
ERIKA: You are remarkably strong.\pThis battle was witnessed, so it
shall stand as your GYM challenge.\pI must confer on you the
RAINBOWBADGE.
{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\pI saw trust in the way your
POKéMON stood with you.\pFriendship can guide evolution
as surely as sunlight guides\la bud into bloom.\pPlease come to CELADON GYM.
There, I will give a reward for\lthe growth you have shown.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ReceivedRainbowKeyFromErika
text: {PLAYER} received the RAINBOW KEY\nfrom ERIKA.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ExplainRainbowKey
text: The RAINBOW KEY opens the\nBERRY PATCH next door to\lCELADON GYM.\pPlease feel free to pick the\nberries growing there.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_LeavingViridianForest
text: LEAVING VIRIDIAN FOREST\nPEWTER CITY AHEAD$

label: ViridianForest_Text_TangrowthVanished
text: TANGROWTH vanished into the\nflowers!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_1F_Text_WaterWarmsMeToCore
text:
Hm!
Haaaaaaaaaaah!\pAaaah! This is heavenly!
The water warms me to my core!\pYou should jump in, too.\pGo to the middle, relax, and get
good and warm!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_1F_Text_EnjoyBowlOfChowder
text: My favorite part of bathing comes\nup right after this.\pI enjoy a bowl of chowder to\nwarm me from the inside, too!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_1F_Text_WaterExquisiteFullyRefreshed
text: The water is perfectly warm.\nIt feels exquisite…\p{PLAYER} and the POKéMON were\nfully refreshed!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_1F_Text_HotSpringIsTherapeutic
text: Soaking in a hot spring pool is\ntherapeutic, people say.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_1F_Text_SeeHowSmoothMySkinIs
text: Have a look at my face.\nSee how smooth my skin is?\pThe hot spring's water keeps my\nskin younger than my age.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_1F_Text_BrunoVisitsSpaOnOccasion
text:
After an honest day of training,
nothing beats a relaxing soak in\lthe hot spring pool.\pBRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,
visits the SPA on occasion.\pHe comes to rehab injuries, both
his own and his POKéMON's.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_1F_Text_KogaLookingForLavicStone
text:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pYou have found me at work,
{PLAYER}.\pI seek a LAVIC STONE, quenched
by the thermal waters of this\lvolcano.\pSuch stone can be shaped into
excellent ninja tools.\pBut even a stone born of fire
needs water to become useful.\pSo it is with people.\pCommunity is what turns many
separate strengths into one.\pTogetherness will allow us to
reach the stone.\pI challenge you, {PLAYER}.\pReach the water source with me,
and prove you understand the\lstrength of moving together!\pNow, follow if you can!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_2F_Text_GarrettIntro
text: A volcano's just a mountain\nwith a temper!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_2F_Text_GarrettDefeat
text: That shook me loose!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_2F_Text_GarrettPostBattle
text: Loose stone, hot air, and hard\nclimbs. That's a real trail.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_LeftCorridor_2F_Text_KogaCheckpoint
text:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pYou kept pace through the heat
and stone.\pGood.
The water source lies deeper still.\pA ninja does not simply rush
toward the goal.\pWe watch the path, trust our allies,
and move as one.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KindlerEmberIntro
text: We train where the embers glow.\nLet us light up this battle!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KindlerEmberDefeat
text: You cooled us down!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KindlerEmberPostBattle
text: A small spark can grow strong.\nSo can a patient trainer.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KiraIntro
text: Hot ground, narrow path...\nPerfect footwork practice!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KiraDefeat
text: Clean movement!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KiraPostBattle
text: A battle here teaches balance\nbetter than any dojo floor.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_ColeIntro
text: Can you handle a little fire\ninside a volcano?$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_ColeDefeat
text: You smothered my spark!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_ColePostBattle
text: The best flames don't flare up.\nThey keep burning steady.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaFountain
text: KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pYou made it this far.\nTogether, no less.\pThen the lesson has already\ntaken root.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaLiftStone
text: KOGA grips the LAVIC STONE\nwith both hands...\p...But it does not move.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaNeedStrength
text: KOGA: Hmph!\nEven quenched, it resists me.\pWe need more strength to lift\nthis stone from its resting place.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_JanineArrives
text: JANINE: Then I made it in time.\pFather, you said togetherness\nwas the point of this trial.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaTryTogether
text: KOGA: Hah!\nYou are right, JANINE.\pThen we shall try together.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_PullTogether
text: KOGA, JANINE, and {PLAYER}\npull with all their strength!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_StonePulledFree
text: The LAVIC STONE breaks loose\nfrom the volcanic rock!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaOfficialChallenge
text:
KOGA: Together, we freed the
stone.\pA community does not weaken
the self.\pIt gives strength somewhere to
stand.\pBack at the GYM, this will become
the heart of new ninja tools.\pBut before I return, I want to
battle you here.\pJANINE stands beside me as my
GYM aide.\pThat makes this challenge
official.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaReadyToBattle
text: Are you ready to battle KOGA?$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaBattleIntro
text: KOGA: Then show me the strength\nyou bring to your allies!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaDefeat
text: Fwahahaha!\nA worthy victory!$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaPostJanine
text: KOGA: The LAVIC STONE waits.\pWith JANINE here, we may yet\nmove it.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaPostStone
text: KOGA: Together, even stubborn\nstone must yield.\pNow, let us make this trial\nofficial.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_KogaAfterBattle
text:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!
You have earned the SOULBADGE!
{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\pReturn to FUCHSIA GYM
when you are ready.\pThere, the LAVIC STONE will become
tools worthy of our clan.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_JaninePostArrival
text: JANINE: If this is for our clan's\ntools, then I should help too.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_RightCorridor_3F_Text_JaninePostStone
text: JANINE: Father never makes these\nlessons easy.\pBut I think that was the point.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaTeachDreamEater
text:
This circle gathers more than
memory.\pIt gathers feeling, fear, grief,
and the will to remain.\pI came here because the tower's
astral energy called to me.\pWhile listening to it, I refined
a PSYCHIC-type move.\pWould you like me to teach it?\pYou will need a POKéMON that can
learn DREAM EATER.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaChoosePokemon
text: Very well.\nChoose the POKéMON to focus.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaComeBackWithPokemon
text: Then return with a POKéMON whose\nmind can reach through dreams.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaTaughtDreamEater
text:
That is DREAM EATER.\pIt draws strength from a sleeping
foe through psychic focus.\pYou remained peaceful inside
the tower's astral pull.\pThat emotional control is
enough for an\lofficial challenge here.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_GymGuideArrives
text: SABRINA!\nI felt the tower settle.\pIf a battle begins here, I will\nwitness it as your GYM aide.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_GymGuideWaiting
text: The tower is quiet now.\pI will witness SABRINA's battle\nwhenever you are ready.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaReadyToBattle
text: Peace is not proven by silence\nalone.\pLet us see how your focus holds\nin battle.\pAre you ready to challenge me?$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaDeclineBattle
text: Then steady yourself.\pWhen your mind is ready, speak\nto me again.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaBattleIntro
text: In this tower, thought and memory\npress close.\pShow me the shape of your will.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaDefeat
text: Your focus did not waver.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_SabrinaAfterBattle
text: The MARSHBADGE is yours.\pYou met the tower's pressure and\nanswered it with peaceful control.\pI will return to SAFFRON GYM.\nCome there when you are ready.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_AngelicaIntro
text: Give…me…\nyour light…$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_AngelicaDefeat
text: Groan!\nThe darkness is lifting.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
text: I feel anemic and weak…$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_EmiliaIntro
text: Urff…\nKwaah!$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_EmiliaDefeat
text: Something left me!\nWas that the spirit?$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_EmiliaPostBattle
text: My hair didn't fall out!\nIt was a malevolent spirit!$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_JenniferIntro
text: Ke…ke…ke…\nke…ke…ke!$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_JenniferDefeat
text: Keee!\nThe astral pull is breaking.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_JenniferPostBattle
text: What's going on here?$
